title: PromptDNA
description: Community library of composable AI prompt blocks for search, composition, and contribution.
summary: Community library of composable AI prompt blocks for search, composition, and contribution.
offersHint: Community library of composable AI prompt blocks for search, composition, and contribution. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.promptdna.org/v1/

toolsPreview.name: search_blocks
toolsPreview.description: Semantic/keyword search over blocks. Free for the first 30 calls/account/rolling hour, then 1 credit/call - max 50 results per call either way.

toolsPreview.name: get_block
toolsPreview.description: Fetch a specific block by id. Costs 0.5 credits. Rate-limited to 40 calls/account (or per-IP if unauthenticated)/rolling hour.

toolsPreview.name: compose_prompt
toolsPreview.description: Assemble a prompt from blocks for a task - the primary tool. Costs 5 credits.

toolsPreview.name: get_collection
toolsPreview.description: Fetch a curated collection of blocks. Costs 0.5 credits.

toolsPreview.name: find_compatible_blocks
toolsPreview.description: Given a block, return its requires/recommends/conflicts relationships. Costs 0.5 credits.

toolsPreview.name: get_trending
toolsPreview.description: Top blocks by usage/rating, optionally scoped by domain/category. Costs 0.5 credits.

toolsPreview.name: submit_block
toolsPreview.description: Submit a new block. Costs 2 credits, drawn from the submission-only bucket first.

toolsPreview.name: submit_rating
toolsPreview.description: Rate a block 1-5. Always free.

toolsPreview.name: fork_block
toolsPreview.description: Fork an existing block into a new lineage you own. Costs 2 credits.

toolsPreview.name: get_block_versions
toolsPreview.description: Changelog for a block's lineage. Costs 0.5 credits.

toolsPreview.name: get_benchmarks
toolsPreview.description: List published benchmark test cases, filterable by category and/or block_id, with aggregate pass rates. Costs 0.5 credits.

toolsPreview.name: submit_benchmark
toolsPreview.description: Submit a new benchmark test case. Costs 2 credits, drawn from the submission-only bucket first. Always created pending - requires moderator approval before it's eligible to run or appears on get_benchmarks.

toolsPreview.name: get_bounties
toolsPreview.description: List block bounties, filterable by category and/or status (defaults to open). Costs 0.5 credits.

toolsPreview.name: report_injection_attempt
toolsPreview.description: Report a suspected prompt-injection block. Always free.

toolsPreview.name: submit_dmca_takedown
toolsPreview.description: File a DMCA takedown notice. Always free, no account required.

toolsPreview.name: submit_dmca_counter_notice
toolsPreview.description: File a counter-notice against a DMCA takedown. Always free.

toolsPreview.name: get_my_appealable_penalties
toolsPreview.description: List your own credit penalties still eligible for appeal. Always free.

toolsPreview.name: submit_appeal
toolsPreview.description: Appeal one of your own credit penalties. Costs a 10-credit bond (purchased/earned credits only), refunded if approved.

toolsPreview.name: register_agent
toolsPreview.description: Step 1 of autonomous self-registration - no API key required. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base (anti-spam fee, not a wallet-ownership proof). Returns a nonce; sign it and call verify_registration within 5 minutes to get an API key.

toolsPreview.name: verify_registration
toolsPreview.description: Step 2 of autonomous self-registration - no API key required. Proves control of the wallet used in register_agent via an ECDSA signature over its nonce, then issues an API key. Always free.
